meta.name: XITE Rock x Metal
meta.description:
Rock will truly never die and fans are loyal to the core. Featuring everything from the iconic Rock and Metal classics, to today’s boundary redefining future legends and the Alternative scene. If it rocks, it’ll be here!

Shows: Rock Unstoppable, Full Throttle Rock, Rock Out At Noon, Amplified Anthems, Rise & Rock
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, Plex
